intent: Generate the telemetry-ingestion-and-processing project root and build scaffold (Java 21, Spring Boot 3, Maven, base package com.pulsestream.telemetry) using the mcp-server-springboot skill from mcp-server-alternatives, with dependencies spring-boot-starter-webflux, spring-boot-starter-data-r2dbc, spring-boot-starter-validation, spring-boot-starter-actuator, flyway-core, flyway-database-postgresql, spring-boot-starter-jdbc, r2dbc-postgresql, postgresql, r2dbc-h2, h2, spring-boot-starter-test, reactor-test. Requirements: (1) a SINGLE composition root: exactly one @SpringBootApplication class, the scaffold's own, and never a second boot class; (2) test-run timeout guardrails: maven-surefire-plugin with forkedProcessTimeoutInSeconds and a JUnit 5 default timeout (junit.jupiter.execution.timeout.default) so a hung test fails fast; (3) the persistence layer owns SQL, so wire a schema MIGRATION RUNNER into the build (Flyway via flyway-core with migrations under src/main/resources/db/migration and a JDBC datasource for the runner) plus the embeddable in-process substitute (h2 and r2dbc-h2) so the scaffold's boot test (contextLoads) passes without external services. Set java.version to 21 in pom.xml and verify with ./mvnw clean install.
